title: Evaluating Model Bias Requires Characterizing its Mistakes

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the SKEWSIZE metric (based on Cramér's V effect size) to measure the association between gender and model predictions for occupations or sports. This was evaluated on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using synthetically generated image datasets with prompts like 'A {GENDER} {OCCUPATION}'.

Measuring the effect size of the interaction between image backgrounds and predicted object classes in ImageNet classifiers. The evaluation used a synthetic dataset generated via Stable Diffusion to place objects across 23 different background types.

Evaluating spurious feature correlation in a controlled setting using the dSprites dataset by intentionally removing specific color-shape combinations during training, and then measuring the effect size of color on the model's shape predictions.
